name: Phosphor Trail
description: A single smooth tube of light follows the recent path of the pointer. A thin bright core sits inside a soft bloom and the stroke keeps the same width from end to end, dimming with age rather than narrowing to a point. The whole tube is one colour at any moment, drawn from the cyan to rose spectrum, and that colour drifts slowly along the spectrum as the seconds pass. A click sends a bright pulse running outward along the stroke. It can be set to appear only once the pointer passes a chosen speed, and to follow a smoothed path so an unsteady hand still gets a clean curve.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the bright core of the stroke (px)

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Strength of the soft bloom around the core, 0 to leave only the core

parameters.name: Colour cycle
parameters.description: Seconds the colour takes to travel once through the whole spectrum, 0 to hold one colour

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which the stroke is not drawn (px per second), 0 to always draw

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path is smoothed before it is drawn, 0 to follow it exactly

parameters.name: Click flare
parameters.description: Brightness of the pulse a click sends along the stroke, 0 to disable
